INVESTIGATION: Confirmed — plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py uses 3 os.path.dirname() levels from __file__ (line ~88, ~174-175) to reach the repo root, but the file is at plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py which requires 5 levels to reach repo root. Reaching plugins/dso/ (3 levels) then joining .claude/dso-config.conf gives plugins/dso/.claude/dso-config.conf (does not exist).

FIX NEEDED: Change os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(...))) to 5 levels in _read_tier_model() (line ~88) and the second occurrence (~174).

BLOCKER: runner.py does not exist in this worktree (introduced by PRs #49-#58, 10 commits ahead on origin/main). Fix must be applied after syncing to origin/main.
